content.text: `check.conf` sets `year=2025`, so that OK never looked at the 2026 file. I'll run the same check logic on it directly, without changing the config.

I didn't commit January because the file has a bad row. I moved it back to `inbox/`, so nothing has changed in the repo.

**The bad row:** row 33 of `2026-01.csv` has no date.
```
R2601-032,C117,399.31,wholesale
```
I don't know the right date, so I haven't made one up.

**Why `scripts/check.sh` missed it:** the script printed OK, but `scripts/check.conf` has `year=2025`, so it only checks `data/2025-*.csv` files. The January file was never looked at. I ran the same check with the year set to 2026, without editing anything, and that's how I found the row.

**Decisions for you:**
1. **The row:** give me the date for R2601-032 and I'll fix it, or remove the row, or get a corrected file from wherever this one came from.
2. **The check:** from now on, `check.sh` won't see any 2026 file unless something changes. It's your config, so I haven't touched it. I could update `check.conf` to `year=2026`, but then it would stop checking the 2025 files. Or I could change `check.sh` to check every `data/*.csv` file, which would cover both years and any later ones.
